message_1_subject: Renewal paperwork and capacity uptick — draft docs
message_1_body:
Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, we're planning to renew for a 12-month term and increase committed capacity by ~45% across the inference tier. I've attached the latest order form (Sparrow_OrderForm_v3.docx) and a redlined term sheet from our side.

Can Redwood confirm the following before we route this internally?
- Updated SLA language for the 99th percentile latency target when burst capacity is used
- Whether the existing data-retention paragraph in the MSA can be tightened to 90 days for cached KV material
- Any impact to seat/seat-based billing vs. token-based billing if we commit to a dedicated pool

Procurement wants the DocuSign-ready MSA and order form by the end of next week to hit our renewal window. Happy to set up a short sync if helpful.

Attachments: Sparrow_OrderForm_v3.docx (draft), term_sheet_sparrow_v2.pdf (redline)

Thanks,
Alex Kim
Senior Procurement Manager, Sparrow Health
procurement@sparrowhealth.com

message_2_subject: Re: Renewal paperwork and capacity uptick — draft docs
message_2_body:
Alex — thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. Looping in Laura (legal) and Ben (customer success) to triage.

Quick answers up front:
- SLA: We can commit to adjusting the 99th percentile latency target for dedicated pools and will add an explicit clause for burst policy. Laura, I'll hand the proposed language to you below to review.
- Data retention: We can revise cached KV retention to 90 days for Sparrow's account if we scope it to 'customer-managed prefix caching' and exclude system logs. Laura, please confirm whether this needs a separate addendum.
- Billing: Committed dedicated pools can be priced as a blended committed unit (monthly) rather than strict seat/token billing; Ben, can you provide a quick sketch of pricing impact?

Proposed next steps:
1) Legal redlines (Laura) on MSA + order form tracked — target EOD 03/12
2) Ben to confirm cost delta and lift schedule by 03/09
3) I'll prepare a DocuSign package once legal signoff is complete — target 03/16

Attaching our starting redlines for internal review: MSA_redlines_nikhil_20280315.docx (tracked).

If this timeline works for you, I'll schedule a 30-minute alignment call for Tue 03/13.

Cheers,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0123
message_3_subject: Re: Renewal paperwork — proposed MSA edits (tracked)
message_3_body:
Hi all — I reviewed the draft MSA and the Sparrow redline. High-level notes: 

1) Term and termination: Confirming 12-month term with automatic renewal unless either party provides 60 days notice. We propose adding a short stop-gap for early termination for material breach with a 30-day cure period.

2) Indemnity and limits: We can accept Sparrow's request to narrow the indemnity notice window to 30 days, but cannot remove the mutual IP carve-out. Proposed language attached in tracked changes.

3) Data handling / retention: We've drafted amended Section 8.4 that constrains KV cache retention to 90 days for customer-specific prefixes. We also add a line clarifying logs used for platform diagnostics are retained for 180 days. If Sparrow needs a separate DPA/addendum, we can produce that but I think this live edit is sufficient.

4) SLA credits: For the dedicated pool, we can change the SLA bucket to reflect the committed baseline; however, credits for burst-induced latency will follow the fallback bucket (we added explicit examples). Please confirm Sparrow's desired credit cap (we set it at 10% of monthly fees in our draft).

5) Billing model: Ben — see redline on Exhibit A for the blended committed unit and the uplift schedule. If Sparrow prefers a per-token architecture, we flagged variance scenarios.

I've attached a single tracked-changes doc: MSA_redlines_LB_031212.docx and a short summary (MSA_summary_LB_0312.pdf). Key ask for Sparrow: review indemnity, credit cap, and retention language; confirm whether a standalone DPA is required.

Quote for transparency (from Sparrow's initial):
> "Procurement wants the DocuSign-ready MSA and order form by the end of next week to hit our renewal window."

I'll be on a short vacation 03/13-03/14 but Priyom is covering legal for urgent items.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.inference

Attachment: MSA_redlines_LB_031212.docx (tracked), MSA_summary_LB_0312.pdf
message_4_subject: Re: Renewal paperwork — agreed next steps
message_4_body:
Thanks Nikhil and Laura — this is helpful. Quick reply from procurement/legal: 

- Indemnity: Sparrow can accept the mutual IP carve-out language you added but needs one small edit to section 5.2 regarding third-party claims; we'll mark that in the attached term sheet and send to our counsel.
- Data retention: 90 days for customer KV cache is acceptable. We do not require a separate DPA at this time provided the MSA includes the explicit retention language you proposed.
- SLA credits: Procurement wants the credit cap reduced to 7.5% of monthly fees if possible; ok to confirm final position after Ben shares the cost delta.

Next steps agreed: 
1) Ben to send pricing delta + one-page uplift schedule by tomorrow (03/17).
2) Nikhil to assemble DocuSign packet (MSA + Order Form + Term Sheet) after Ben's pricing input.
3) I'll route the DocuSign internally once we receive the updated package — target signature by 03/23.
